# Strategy Catalog

**100 declarative strategies**, interpreted at runtime by `DeclarativeStrategy` (`src/botfarm/strategy/generic.py`) from the YAML specs in `src/botfarm/catalog/specs/`. Generated by `src/botfarm/catalog/generate_catalog_md.py` -- do not hand-edit this file, edit the specs (or `scripts/generate_strategy_catalog.py`, which produced them) and regenerate instead.

**None of these have been individually backtested for edge.** Only bot #1 (a hand-picked, fully bespoke strategy, not from this catalog) has a real backtest report -- see `reports/bot01_mean_reversion/`. A handful of these specs were smoke-tested (`scripts/smoke_test_catalog.py`) only to confirm the engine runs them correctly end-to-end, not that any of them have an edge. Given the negative-expectancy finding documented for bot01 across 15 variants (see `docs/RISK_DISCLAIMER.md`), assume the same is likely true here until proven otherwise by an actual backtest.
